title: Accounting and Tax Services for Specialist Physicians

rows.before: We incorporated a Medicine Professional Corporation with a CPSO Certificate of Authorization, rolled the practice in on a section 85 election, moved retained earnings to the 12.2% small-business rate, restructured the portfolio to keep aggregate investment income under the $50,000 passive-income threshold, and established an Individual Pension Plan the MPC deducts on its T2.
rows.after: We incorporated a Medicine Professional Corporation with a CPSO Certificate of Authorization, rolled the practice in on a section 85 election, moved retained earnings to the 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026) small-business rate, restructured the portfolio to keep aggregate investment income under the $50,000 passive-income threshold, and established an Individual Pension Plan the MPC deducts on its T2.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).

rows.before: We restructured the share ownership, documented the excluded-business and return-on-capital tests, set a salary-and-dividend mix that kept active income under the $500,000 limit taxed at 12.2%, and deferred the surplus corporately rather than drawing it, capturing the spread between the corporate and top personal rates.
rows.after: We restructured the share ownership, documented the excluded-business and return-on-capital tests, set a salary-and-dividend mix that kept active income under the $500,000 limit taxed at 11.2%, and deferred the surplus corporately rather than drawing it, capturing the spread between the corporate and top personal rates.
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).

rows.before: Deferred tax on retained earnings at roughly 12.2%
rows.after: Deferred tax on retained earnings at roughly 11.2%
rows.note: Case-study result stated without a date as the current SBD-taxed rate; treated as current. If Sharad dates this engagement before July 1, 2026, switch to R3 (leave).
